# NGAP: compliance register

What this is: the requirements of this area that are built and verified against running code, the typed rows recorded while building them, and coverage counts derived from the specs (verification.md §5). Requirements are in [`requirements.md`](../../requirements.md); deviations in [`deviations.md`](../deviations.md).

Specs read: TS 38.413 j40.

Row suffixes (requirements.md): -D defect in the sim, -B a choice the spec leaves open, -G declared gap, -V deviation from a "shall", -S spec contradiction and the reading chosen, -M mutant, -T T0 reading or measurement, -F a kaluza-core defect the sim found, -X retired. Verification: U unit, KAT or oracle test; F fuzz or property test; I interop; L lab; G gate row; A real-device comparison.

The policy is a topology setting, cucp {up_policy: {...}}, and ksim-ctl gnb <name> up-policy changes it at run time for the sessions after. Every decision is a ran.up.security event (indication present or absent, what was asked, what was done, set-up or the refusal's cause). The stub's AMF takes a refusal with either UP security cause. | KS-NGAP-B9 | 2026-10-16 | PDU SESSION RESOURCE MODIFY end to end at the CU-CP (P2 Q10; TS 38.413 8.2.3, 8.2.4). It is a UE job like a setup, queued behind any procedure the UE has running. Each session's change is planned first (flows released, then added or modified, and the AMBR). Then E1 sets up, remaps and removes the CU-UP's DRBs and gives the DL session-AMBR. F1 sets up, modifies and releases the DU's DRBs. The DU's F1-U ends of new DRBs go back over E1. Then one RRCReconfiguration carries the new DRBs, the changed mappings (no pdcp-Config), the released DRBs, the DU's cell group and the sessions' NAS. The response goes once the UE completes it: the flows added or modified, and the ones that could not be added with radio-resources-not-available. A change with nothing for the radio (the AMBR, a flow's QoS on the same DRB) sends the NAS in DLInformationTransfer. A failure on the way answers every session as failed to modify, and the sessions keep what they had at the CU-CP. A flow released by the gNB itself (ksim-ctl gnb <name> qos-release <ue> --psi N --qfi N) goes the same way and is told in PDU SESSION RESOURCE NOTIFY with radioNetwork release-due-to-ngran-generated-reason. The AMF gets no response for it. | src/proc/ran/cucp.cpp; tests/procedure Session.Ts38413_8_2_3_*, Session.Ts38413_8_2_4_*; P2 Q10 |
